svg.title: Athena system architecture: sources feed two Celery pipelines (the feed and the research maps), which write to PostgreSQL, Qdrant and Redis; FastAPI serves them to the React app; workers and the API call one OpenAI-compatible model server.
svg.text: evolution worker · one job at a time
